'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ben Paatela LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ben Paatela]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ben Paakla
* '''Deck name:''' Credits
* '''Username:''' Walseth
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
